title: Default branch: the rules and skills say the default branch for daily work, and a release keeps a merge commit
seam: daily-branch lines of baselines/BASE_CLAUDE.md, baselines/global/GLOBAL_CLAUDE.md, the skill files, .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, CLAUDE.md
story: orion's rules and skills used to say main wherever they meant the branch daily work starts from. They now say the default branch and look it up, so a project can work on a develop branch and release to main; projects that only use main see no change.
no_qa_reason: Rules and skill wording only; nothing a user drives.
